fact: The Global Partnership for Education blog says the EU-financed PESIDE project aims to strengthen the Education Management Information System (EMIS) and related systems in Guinea-Bissau.

FEC says practical training on the SIGE 2.0 education information and management platform began on 6 October 2025 in Tombali, Quinara, Bafata and Gabu, under the EU-funded PESIDE project with the Ministry of Education.
system: SIGE 2.0 (Sistema de Informacao e Gestao da Educacao)
